Frequently asked questions

What is a Telegram AI video generator?

It creates video content for Telegram channels, groups, and communities. With VideoAll, generate from text or an image, download the result, then share it on Telegram.

Can I generate AI videos directly inside Telegram?

No. VideoAll works in a web browser, not as a Telegram bot. Create and download on VideoAll, then upload the video to Telegram.

Can I create Telegram videos from text and images?

Yes. VideoAll supports text-to-video and image-to-video workflows for content you share on Telegram.
